memories.content: HR is responsible for reviewing applications for the ward-clerk vacancy. They have received eleven applications by the closing time. They have internal criteria for selecting candidates to invite for interview, but no decision has been made yet.

The posting for the ward-clerk vacancy at Calloway Regional Hospital closed at 23:59 on 2026-09-30. Eleven applications were received. The hospital typically invites some applicants for interview within two weeks of closing.
